test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 13 Nov, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: According to the census of India 2011, which union territory of India has the highest literacy rate?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Lakshadweep**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• According to the Census of India 2011, **Lakshadweep** recorded the highest literacy rate among Union Territories, at **91.85%**.
 
• The literacy rate represents the percentage of the population aged 7 years and above who can read and write with understanding.
 
• Lakshadweep's high literacy rate is attributed to effective educational policies and programs implemented in the region.
 
• Kerala, which is often associated with high literacy rates in India, also influenced the educational practices in Lakshadweep due to cultural and administrative proximity.
 
• Among Union Territories, Lakshadweep was followed closely by Chandigarh (86.43%) and Delhi (86.34%) in terms of literacy rates.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Literacy Rate:**

 
 
• The literacy rate is defined as the percentage of literate individuals in a specific age group, typically 7 years and above.
 
• It is calculated by dividing the number of literate individuals by the total population in the relevant age group and multiplying by 100.
 
 
 
• **Census of India:**
 
 
• The Census of India is conducted every 10 years by the Office of the Registrar General & Census Commissioner under the Ministry of Home Affairs.
 
• The 2011 Census was the 15th National Census of India since 1872.
 
• It provides comprehensive data on demographics, socio-economic conditions, and literacy levels across the country.
 
 
 
• **Union Territories in India:**
 
 
• India has several Union Territories, which are administrative divisions governed directly by the central government.
 
• Examples include Lakshadweep, Delhi, Chandigarh, Puducherry, and others.
 
 
 
• **Education Policies:**
 
 
• Programs like Sarva Shiksha Abhiyan (SSA) and the Right to Education Act have contributed significantly to improving literacy rates in India.
 
• Special focus on remote regions like Lakshadweep has helped bridge disparities in educational access.
